spanish: Sobre plancha en el aceite será hecha; remojada la traerás; cocidos de minjá de pedazos acercarás, olor de reposo a Jehová.

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun untranslated; a non-name lemma must be Spanish
remojada selects soaked; the hophal participle also covers mixed or stirred
cocidos narrows the masculine plural construct noun to cooked; the lemma is baked pieces or cakes

notes: Remaining clauses match prepositions, niphal 3fs, 2ms plus 3fs suffix, construct chain, and Jehová.
